title: EpixChain v0.7.5 Upgrade: Osaka EVM Rules and Maintenance
summary:
What changes:
- Activates the Osaka EVM rules, bringing EpixChain in line with current Ethereum execution behaviour. This includes a per-transaction gas limit of 16,777,216. Transactions that request more gas than that are rejected after the upgrade.
- Includes upstream Cosmos EVM maintenance and hardening.
